## Interactions & Behaviors

### Left Sidebar
- **Section accordion headers:** Clicking the section title or chevron (∧/∨) collapses/expands that section. State is preserved per user [INFERRED].
- **"Relationships" add button (blue person icon):** Opens a contact-linking modal to associate this person with another person record (e.g., spouse, co-buyer) [INFERRED].
- **"+" in Relationships:** Same — add new relationship [INFERRED].
- **LinkedIn link ("Laurie McAdam"):** Opens LinkedIn.com search/profile in a new tab [INFERRED].
- **Google link ("Search Laurie McAdam"):** Opens Google search in a new tab [INFERRED].
- **"Add background":** Inline text area or modal appears to type a background note about the contact [INFERRED].
- **"Delete person":** Opens confirmation dialog — "Are you sure you want to delete Laurie McAdam? This cannot be undone." [INFERRED].

### Activity Feed Filter Bar
- **Filter tabs (All, Email, Comment, Phone, etc.):** Clicking a tab filters the timeline to show only events of that type. The count badge on each tab shows how many events of that type exist in the timeline.
- **"Filters ∨" button:** Opens a dropdown overlay with additional filter options (date range, assigned agent, etc.) [INFERRED].

### Activity Feed Entries
- **"∨" dropdown on sender → recipient header:** Opens a small popover to change which agent the activity is attributed to, or to see full recipient list [INFERRED].
- **"View campaign email" link:** Opens the full HTML campaign email in a modal or new tab [INFERRED].
- **Reply button (↩ Reply):** Opens an inline email compose panel below the entry, pre-populated with the recipient and subject as a reply thread [INFERRED].
- **Forward icon:** Opens compose panel for forwarding the email to a different recipient [INFERRED].
- **"•••" (more options):** Context menu with options like: "Delete", "Log note", "Archive", "Copy link" [INFERRED].
- **Attachment link (Ryan-Realty-CMA-62285-Deer-Trail-Rd.pdf):** Downloads or previews the PDF in a modal [INFERRED].

### Right Sidebar Widgets
- **"+" buttons on each section:** Opens an appropriate modal/form for that widget type:
  - Tasks "+": Add task modal (text, due date, assignee, type)
  - Appointments "+": Schedule appointment modal (date/time, type, note)
  - Deals "+": Create deal modal (address, price, stage)
  - Files "+": File upload dialog (or drag-and-drop target)
  - Collaborators "+": Agent/team-member picker
  - Automations "+": Automation selection modal [INFERRED]
- **Task checkbox:** Clicking marks the task as complete; item removed from the active tasks view [INFERRED].
- **Task due date (overdue):** Clicking allows editing the due date [INFERRED].
- **Automation pause button (∥):** Pauses the running automation for this contact; status changes to "Paused" [INFERRED].
- **AgentFire FUB Widget "∨" (collapsed):** Expanding would show an embedded AgentFire widget panel (third-party integration showing property activity or lead source data from AgentFire) [INFERRED].
- **"Files" section — drag-and-drop:** Files can be dragged from desktop and dropped onto the section to upload them to the contact record [INFERRED].

### Bottom Bar
- **[→] keyboard shortcut:** Navigates to the next lead/contact in the current list without going back to the list view.
- **[←] keyboard shortcut:** Navigates to the previous lead/contact.
- **"Continue Getting Started" button:** Opens the FUB onboarding checklist wizard (showing 2/7 steps complete).
- **"?" help button:** Opens FUB's in-app help/support chat or help center [INFERRED].

## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person / Contact** — core entity. Fields revealed: name, age, gender, location (city, state, country), LinkedIn URL, Google search URL, lender (FK to lender entity or free text). Has: background (text note), custom fields (extensible key-value), relationships (FK to other Person records), social profile (enriched from data provider).
- **Email / Activity** — events on the contact timeline. Fields: sender (user FK), recipient (contact FK), to_address (email string), BCC address (string), subject, body (HTML/text), sent_at (timestamp), event_source ("automation" | "manual"), campaign_id (FK if automation), opens_count (integer).
- **Automation Enrollment** — contact-level running record. Fields: automation_id (FK), automation_name (string), started_at (timestamp), status (enum: "Running" | "Paused" | "Completed" | "Stopped").
- **Task** — Fields: text (string), task_type (enum: "call" | "email" | "to-do" | etc.), due_at (datetime), assigned_to (user FK), contact_id (FK), completed (boolean), is_overdue (computed: due_at < now() AND !completed).
- **Appointment** — Fields: contact_id (FK), scheduled_at (datetime), type (string), notes (text). Zero state: "No upcoming appointments."
- **Deal** — Fields: contact_id (FK), address, price, stage. Zero state: "No deals yet."
- **File** — Fields: contact_id (FK), filename (string), size_bytes (integer), url (string), uploaded_at (datetime). Zero state: "No files yet, drag some here."
- **Collaborator** — FK join between User and Contact; allows multiple agents to be associated with one contact.
- **Campaign Email** — automation-originated email with pixel tracking. Fields: pixel_url (string with _pxl param), opens_count (integer), view_campaign_email_url (string). The email body is "archived" in this view — the actual content is accessed via "View campaign email" link.

### Enums / Values
- `task_type`: "call" (shown with green phone icon)
- `automation_status`: "Running" (green dot), "Paused" [INFERRED], "Completed" [INFERRED]
- `email_source`: "via automation", (blank = manual)
- `opens_count` badge: singular "1 open" vs plural "2 opens"
- `task_due` display: overdue dates shown in orange/amber color

### Relationships
- Person → has many Activities (emails, calls, notes, etc.)
- Person → has many Tasks
- Person → has many Appointments
- Person → has many Deals
- Person → has many Files
- Person → has many Collaborators (Users)
- Person → has many Automation Enrollments
- Person → has many Relationships (self-referential, typed link to other Persons)
- Activity (email) → belongs to Campaign (if automation-sourced)
- Task → assigned to User

### FUB-Specific Signals
- BCC address `ryan.realty@followupboss.me` — FUB's email-capture BCC address auto-files sent emails into the contact timeline. The domain prefix (`ryan.realty`) is the team's unique FUB routing identifier.
- Pixel tracking URLs: `https://ryan-realty.com?_pxl=djoxLGM6...` — FUB injects a pixel tracking query param into campaign links to count email opens.
- AgentFire FUB Widget: a third-party CRM widget integration embedded as a collapsible section in the right sidebar.
- "Web Inquiry Option 01" — auto-enrollment automation triggered by the contact's original lead source (web inquiry).

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **"via automation" label:** Activities triggered by an automation enrollment have the "via automation" text appended to the date. Manually sent items have no suffix.

2. **Opens count badge:** The badge is generated by pixel tracking. The URL in the email body contains a `_pxl=` query parameter. Each time the recipient loads the tracking pixel, FUB increments the open count. The badge text is: `{count} open{count > 1 ? 's' : ''}`.

3. **"archived" subject + body:** When automation campaign emails are archived/expired or when the campaign is no longer active, FUB appears to display the body as "archived" with a tracking URL. The full email content is accessible via "View campaign email." This may indicate that campaign emails are not stored inline but only referenced by campaign ID.

4. **BCC logging address:** When composing emails from FUB, the system automatically BCCs `ryan.realty@followupboss.me`. If the agent composes from an external email client (Gmail), they must manually BCC this address for the email to appear in the contact's timeline.

5. **Overdue task color:** Task due dates are rendered in orange/amber when `dueAt < now()` AND `completed === false`. No special icon is added — only the color changes.

6. **Automation pause button:** The ∥ pause button appears inline in the automation row. There is no separate "manage automations" page from this view — pausing/resuming happens directly in the widget.

7. **Filter tab counts:** The counts in the filter tabs represent totals across the entire contact history, not just what's currently visible in the viewport. Switching tabs re-queries/re-filters the timeline.

8. **"2 of 7" context in bottom bar:** This number comes from the currently active smart list or search result the user was viewing when they clicked into this contact. It enables prev/next keyboard navigation through a result set without returning to the list.

9. **Getting Started bar:** FUB shows this teal bar to all new accounts until all onboarding steps are completed. It is dismissible but shown prominently. The `Continue Getting Started` button opens the onboarding checklist modal.

10. **AccordionSection default states:** "Details" and "Custom Fields" are collapsed by default (or the user has collapsed them). "Financing", "Background", "Social Profile", and "Relationships" are expanded. State is likely persisted per-user in localStorage or user preferences [INFERRED].

11. **Right sidebar widget order:** The order of widgets (Tasks → Appointments → AgentFire Widget → Deals → Automations → Files → Collaborators) appears to be a fixed default order, not user-configurable in this view [INFERRED].

12. **AgentFire FUB Widget:** This is a third-party integration section. Its collapsed state and lack of a "+" add button differentiates it from native FUB sections. It likely embeds an iframe or renders an AgentFire-supplied panel when expanded.
